[[File:Vampyre Juvinate icon.png|left]]
[[File:Juvinate guard chathead.png|left|80px]]
[[File:Juvinate guard female chathead.png|left|80px]]
'''Vampyre Juvinates''' are a class of [[vampyres]] who were once human found in [[Burgh de Rott Woods]], the strange castle in south-east [[Meiyerditch]], and tier one [[Darkmeyer]]. They cannot be killed with normal weapons. Instead, they can only be harmed by weak [[silver weapons]] (such as [[Silverlight]], [[silver sickle (b)]], [[silver bolts]], a [[blessed hatchet]], or a [[Wolfbane]] dagger) and [[blisterwood]] weapons. If a [[Guthix balance]] is used on them, one of three things can occur:
* The vampyre dies instantly, granting 100 [[Prayer]] experience (uncommon).
* They become [[Former vampyre|human]] again for a reward (uncommon).
* The vampyre gets angry. Its appearance changes to that of an [[angry vampyre]], and it can be hurt by any weapon (very common).

If a Guthix balance potion is not used, then the Juvinate will say "Ha ha, time to disappear and re-juvinate!", turn into [[Mist]], and float away when it reaches approximately 0 [[life points]]. No drops will be received when this happens. The ones in Darkmeyer are immune to the balance potion and do not turn into mist. They also count for vampyre [[slayer assignments]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (3 May 2016)|date=3 May 2016}}
** [[Vampyre juveniles]] and juvinates will move on from South East [[Meiyerditch]] after the quest [[River of Blood]] is completed.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch_Notes_(20 July 2015)|date=20 July 2015}}
** Vampyre Juvinates will no longer count towards [[Vyrewatch]] Slayer assignments and will correctly count towards vampyre assignments.
** Vampyre Juvinates are now consistently capitalised.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (12 March 2013)|date=12 March 2013}}
** Some stretching issues with Vampyre juvinates have been corrected.

* {{UL|type=update|update=In Aid of the Myreque|date=22 March 2006}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
[[File:Vampyre Juvinate death.gif|right|frame|A Vampyre Juvinate turning to dust]]
* Vampyre Juvinates and Vampyre juvinates used to be significantly different, the latter having a much older, albeit unique, model, despite being released later. The [[graphical updates]] to [[Morytania]] and vampyres solved this, making the two look the same. The combat levels and capitalisation remained different though.
* [[Deflect curses]] seems to inflict damage on them. This may be a bug.
* The female juvinates seem to be wearing a smaller version of [[Drakan's medallion]]. A similar symbol is found on the belts of the male juvinates.
